applies_to: Lochinvar Power-fin models 502-1302 and 1501-2001, with the SMART SYSTEM control and the Modbus/BACnet communication board.
summary: Lochinvar's Power-fin talks BACnet MS/TP through an add-on Modbus/BACnet communication board. The object map is small and fixed: binary values for enable and tank thermostat commands, binary inputs for safety switches and relay states, analog inputs for temperatures, firing rate, cascade data and status, blocking and lockout codes, and analog values the BAS can write for setpoints and remote sensor values.
default_device_instance: 640000 + MAC address (base is model dependent and can be changed)
notes: BACnet needs the optional Lochinvar Modbus/BACnet communication board; address and baud rate are set on its dip switches.
The analog value rows are printed with type 'AI' under the 'Analog Values' heading; the control-mode tables call them AV0-AV3, so they are listed here as AV 0-7.
AV 0 (Configuration) is a bitmask: set a bit to 1 to make the boiler use the BAS-written value instead of its own input.
BAS-supplied temperatures must be rewritten every few seconds and other commands at least every 4 minutes, or the unit reverts to local control.
Temperatures are in °C on the bus.

integration.summary: Set parameter H5 ModBus to Active at the boiler, then write AV 0 Configuration so the unit knows which values the BAS will supply. After that the BAS sends an enable (BV 0, or the packed AV 1), a rate command (AV 2), or both, and keeps rewriting them. Status, temperatures and the status, blocking and lockout codes can be read without taking control.

integration.enable: Set parameter H5 ModBus to Active. Then: enable only (local setpoints) = AV 0 0x0001 and AV 1 0x0001; enable plus rate = AV 0 0x0005, AV 1 0x0001 and AV 2 rate; rate alone = AV 0 0x0004 and AV 2. AV 2 means firing % or a temperature setpoint depending on the BMS Type setting; as a setpoint it is scaled like a 0-10 V signal between the BMS temperatures at low and high input.
integration.heartbeat: BAS-written system and tank temperatures must be refreshed within the timeout set in parameter H6 (5-120 s, default 10 s; another section of the manual gives 1-255 s); other commands must be refreshed at least every 4 minutes. If either timer expires the control reverts to its local inputs. Lochinvar recommends the shortest H6 setting.
integration.remote_sensors: Set the AV 0 bits for the values the BAS will supply, then write them: AV 3 tank setpoint, AV 4 tank temperature, AV 5 outdoor temperature, AV 6 system supply and AV 7 system return temperature, all in °C. For remote DHW, AV 0 = 0x004A with AV 1 = 0x0008 (tank thermostat), AV 3 and AV 4.
setup: MAC address from dip switches 1-8 (master, so 0-127); baud from switches 9-10: 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800.
Device instance = base 640000 + MAC address; the base can be changed (0-4194048) and reset by powering up with dip switches 1-8 on.
gotchas: The manual says to resend the AV 0 configuration bits before each command.
In a cascade only the leader needs the board for control; it then reports cascade totals only, so fit a board to every unit to see each one.
Without H5 ModBus active the board is monitor-only.
AV 2 is sent as a whole percent; for a setpoint it must be converted with the BMS low/high temperature scaling.
